name: lan-watch-plugin
description: Watches your local network: logs every device joining and leaving (by MAC) and flags unknown devices. Pair with Text Me to get texted.
author: AGNT

schema.title: LAN Watch
schema.description: Scans this computer's local network, records join/leave events with timestamps, and sets alert=true when an unknown device appears or returns. Run it on a timer.

knownDevices.description: MAC addresses of devices you trust (comma or newline separated). The router and this computer are always trusted.

leftAfterMinutes.description: Minutes a device must be absent before it counts as having left (1-1440).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for alert times, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to this computer's.

alert.description: True when an unknown device appeared or came back this scan.

message.description: A ready-to-send alert text, empty when alert is false.

unknownOnline.description: Unknown devices currently online, with when they arrived.

logPath.description: Path of the event log (JSON lines).

error.description: Why the scan failed, or null.
